newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices ease with demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices ease with demand.

text.p: Millfeed prices edged lower at several key locations in reaction to easing demand and in some instances to increased supplies, dealers said.

Kansas and Texas dealers said a slowdown in demand was tied to feedmixers replacing millfeeds in rations. Dealers said recent sharp gains in millfeed prices prompted mixers to find other feed ingredients.
Southeast dealers said a slowdown in use by commercial catfish farms also weighed on values. Catfish eat less during the winter months, creating a seasonal decline in demand.
Supplies were also increasing. Dealers in the Midwest and northeast said flour mills increased operations to seven days a week from six because of increased flour sales.
